method: I ran `codex --version`, generated the installed binary's app-server JSON schemas with `codex app-server generate-json-schema`, and cross-checked the hook enum against the current Codex Hooks manual and strings embedded in `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/codex/0.145.0/codex-aarch64-apple-darwin`. I registered `Stop` through a command-line config override and ran `codex exec --ephemeral --ignore-user-config --strict-config --skip-git-repo-check --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust --enable hooks` with the prompt `Reply with exactly OK and do not call tools.` in `/private/tmp/codex-hook-measurement.joI4fe`. The capture script only appended stdin to `/private/tmp/codex-hook-measurement.joI4fe/stop-hook-stdin.log`.

results.fired_when_triggered: VERIFIED. The trivial prompt produced assistant message `OK`, followed by `turn.completed`; `/private/tmp/codex-hook-measurement.joI4fe/stop-hook-stdin.log` contains one 316-byte JSON object from the registered `Stop` hook.

results.can_block_or_continue: YES. The current Codex Hooks release manual states that `Stop` JSON stdout may return `{"decision":"block","reason":"..."}` (or exit 2 with the reason on stderr); Codex then continues by creating a new continuation prompt from that reason. It also states that `continue:false` takes precedence over continuation decisions. Source: `/private/tmp/codex-hook-measurement.joI4fe/manual-cache/codex-manual.md` lines 18659-18679. The continuation output was documented but not triggered in this side-effect-free capture-only test.

conclusion: Codex 0.145.0 has a verified Claude-Code-`Stop` equivalent named `Stop`, and it fires when a model turn tries to finish. Its documented output contract can re-engage the model, so the Grove guard has a viable Codex lifecycle surface on this measured version.
caveats: This result is scoped to codex-cli 0.145.0 on macOS 14.7.6 arm64. The hook's firing and stdin payload were observed directly; the continuation/block behavior was verified from the current release manual rather than exercised, to keep the registered measurement script capture-only. `transcript_path` was null because the run used `--ephemeral`.
